svg.title: Answering a question with sources
svg.desc: 1. The employee asks in AI Partner; the API checks the session and company. 2. The company's agent calls the document search tool on the API. 3. The API limits the search to documents tagged for the employee's role and runs vector search with reranking. 4. The answer streams back over server-sent events with numbered citations. 5. The web app opens the cited document at the right page.
